jordan: PTAL — PR #4723: refactor attn kernel tiling + batcher tweak (kv prefetch window default -> 3). CI started but flaky on unit `test_attn_tile::test_tiling_edgecase`. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4723 :eyes:

ci-bot: build started for PR 4723 — linux-latest, gpu-integration

ana: I'll grab this. Noted the prefetch change; could be race with prewarm.

mike: tldr; can someone run `./scripts/run_unit.sh tests/runtime/test_attn_tile.py::test_tiling_edgecase` locally? CI logs had `IndexError: out of bounds`.

jordan: repro steps I used:
```
python -m pytest tests/runtime/test_attn_tile.py::test_tiling_edgecase -q -k "cpu or gpu"
# or
./bin/local_bench --model gpt2 --seq 2048 --batch 8
```
I saw failure ~1/20 runs.

ana: running now on my devbox (A100). If I reproduce, I'll capture a minimal reproducer and add logs.

ana: reproduced. attaching trimmed log:
```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "tests/runtime/test_attn_tile.py", line 78, in test_tiling_edgecase
    out = tiled_attention(x, mask)
IndexError: index 4096 is out of bounds for axis 1 with size 4096
```
Looks like off-by-one in tiling start index.

mike: hmm maybe kernel assumes full multiple of tile_size. PR changed tile padding. Can you try patching +1 guard in kernel shim? Something like:
```
start = min(start, seq_len - tile_size)
```

ana: tried that locally — fixes the test, but makes perf slightly worse (~2% p99 on seq 2048). Should we prefer correctness over micro p99 for now?

jordan: we should prioritize correctness. We can optimize later. If we accept perf delta, can we add a canary flag to toggle new logic?

mike: +1 to correctness. Add a flag `runtime.attn.tile_safe=true` default true; add comment and small unit. Also update changelog.

ana: opened follow-up commit that applies clamp, adds unit and a short note. Pushed as commit abc123.

ci-bot: CI re-run: linux-latest passed, gpu-integration queued.

ci-bot: gpu-integration flaky test rerun passed.

jordan: thanks both. @mike are you happy to approve?

mike: LGTM, leaving one nit about docstring. Approving now. :shipit:

deploy-bot: PR 4723 merged by mike at 1767882480

jordan: nice, will follow up with perf ticket to re-evaluate tiling perf. assigning to @ana. :sparkles:
